versions.subject: Update global ID
versions.detection:
selection_1:
    ServiceFileName|re: '^%systemroot%\\[a-zA-Z]{8}\.exe$'
    ServiceName|re: '(^[a-zA-Z]{4}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{8}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{16}$)'
    ServiceStartType: '3'  # on-demand start, see https://www.ultimatewindowssecurity.com/securitylog/encyclopedia/event.aspx?eventID=4697
    ServiceType: '0x10'
filter:
    ServiceName: 'PSEXESVC'
condition: selection and selection_1 and not filter
selection:
    EventID: 7045
selection:
    EventID: 4697
versions.spl: EventID=4697 ServiceStartType="3" ServiceType="0x10" NOT ServiceName="PSEXESVC" | regex ServiceFileName="^%systemroot%\\\\[a-zA-Z]{8}\\.exe$" | regex ServiceName="(^[a-zA-Z]{4}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{8}$)|(^[a-zA-Z]{16}$)"
